changed.headline: Psychologist-reviewed AI-generated feedback in internet-delivered CBT for social anxiety was not shown to match therapist feedback in a randomized trial of 263 adults: the difference was small and inconclusive.

Medical students randomized to receive an AI-generated lecture summary before each quiz scored higher in 9 of 11 clerkship cohorts, but the difference between students was only +0.28 of 10 points and not significant.

Because of AI, junior-college medical interns on a neurology rotation in Chongqing who got DeepSeek-supported case-based teaching scored higher on a simulated neurological-emergency assessment than interns on conventional teaching, in a randomized study of 118 interns.

Because of AI, endoscopists using real-time voice-guided navigation covered more of the guideline-recommended biliopancreatic scanning stations in a randomized trial of 266 patients, though procedures took longer.

Because of AI, women in infertility treatment at one Korean clinic who used a Claude-based chatbot self-management program showed a larger fall in perceived stress than women on usual clinic care, in a small non-randomized feasibility study.

In a randomized crossover trial, 83% of 30 adults preferred a human-administered occupational therapy initial assessment to a remote AI-administered one, and rated the human format as more compassionate.

AI-assisted radiograph training did not significantly improve undergraduate dental students' diagnosis of proximal caries compared with conventional training, in a randomized study of 79 students in Saudi Arabia.

Because of AI, obstetrics and gynecology residents who trained with an AI virtual-patient platform scored higher on colposcopy case analysis after one month than residents on traditional teaching alone, in a randomized trial of 60 residents at two Chinese teaching hospitals.

verifications.detail: evidence: drafter A, verifier could not grade.

The source supports higher retrieval and live birth rates associated with AI assistance in a retrospective cohort, without establishing causation. All quoted numbers appear, although its stated 11.5-point live birth increase is inconsistent with 38.5% minus 26.8%, which equals 11.7 points.

The article reports approximately 3,600 wildfire incidents flagged by an operational AI-enabled camera network, with more than half detected before public 911 calls. It supplies no dated observation period, isolated AI effect, or measured reduction in wildfire harm.

The article supports a utility meteorologist's statement that its AI-assisted camera system alerts it about 45 minutes before the first 911 call on average. It provides neither underlying comparative data nor dates for that average.
